# A SNGL function that calls an async native becomes async itself.
# The generated JS must use the async keyword and await at the call site.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# The SNGL wrapper function is emitted as an async function.
grep 'async function loadAll' out/index.html

# The async native call is awaited inside loadAll.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import api "js://./api"

func loadAll() {
    api.fetchHello("test")
}

component main {
    button(text="Go", @click { loadAll() })
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(url: string): Promise<string> { return "hi"; }
